title: Textual Analysis II
modules: Le Gagnant Du Gros Lot Est Mort
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for nouns in general."
The definite article is used for nouns in general.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the worst season of the year."
Harmattan is the worst season of the year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a casual conversation between two students in an interview form."
The French passage you just read is a casual conversation between two students in an interview form.
fib: ______ is a dialogue which centres on a dispute between two children.
The passage is a dialogue which centres on a dispute between two children.
______ is used when referring to an undetermined quantity of a noncountable item.
The partitive is used when referring to an undetermined quantity of a noncountable item.
